title: Count a tree
summary: How many files and how many directories are inside a directory, at any depth.
hints: A helper `walk(const char *dir)` calls itself for each subdirectory. Build the child path with `snprintf(path, sizeof(path), "%s/%s", dir, name)`, and **skip `.` and `..`**: without that the recursion never ends.
An entry is a directory if `opendir(path)` succeeds (close it again with `closedir`); otherwise treat it as a file.
